title: 2 eggs are better than 1 (probably)
summary: Rosen Score trophy hunt: beat ~2000 players with 'Double Egg' (moves spelling E-G-G-E-G-G, e.g. e-pawn, g-pawn, g-pawn twice over); also mentions BeachCafe as the last remaining one. Plays 30-second games; loses rating on failed attempts (down to 2020) before winning with Double Egg.
rules: Rosen Score 'word opening' challenge: the first letters of your first N moves in algebraic notation must spell the target word (pawn moves start with their file letter a-h; piece moves with B/N/R/Q/K, so 'B' can be a bishop move or a b-pawn move).
The opening only counts (Rosen Score trophy) if you go on to WIN the game; he aborts/abandons attempts when the opponent blocks the spelling.
Captures still count by the moving piece's first letter (e.g. a g-pawn capture is still 'G').
Target word: EGG EGG (Double Egg) -> your first 17 moves must start with the letters E, G, G, E, G, G, (, D, O, U, B, L, E, E, G, G, ).
Time control he uses: 30 seconds (bullet) to flag opponents.
win_condition: Spell EGG EGG (Double Egg) with your opening moves AND win the game.

board.theme_notes: chess.com green/cream; Rosen Score website shown between games (trophy list)

events: Rosen Score trophy unlocked on win
current_impl_issues: Legacy 'reproduce' (pawns leave baby pawns) - invented; video is the Rosen Score Double Egg spelling challenge.
